description:
Muichiro is driven into a corner as he is trapped in water by Gyokko`s Blood Demon Art amidst their battle. Meanwhile, Tanjiro and his comrades have successfully severed the necks of the four demons, but seeing that they haven`t turned to dust, they realize that they cannot be defeated just by having their necks severed simultaneously. At that moment, Tanjiro senses the presence of a fifth demon as Genya aims for its neck...
Source: Crunchyroll

titles.title: Aren`t You Going to Become a Hashira?
Hashira ni Narun ja Nai no ka!
Tu veux devenir un pilier, non ?
Wolltest du nicht zur Säule werden?
柱になるんじゃないのか!
